messages.subject: Error: ... could not find function "ggplotGrob"
parts:
Dear all,

I tried to run the code I found here:
http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/794605ca62dd3830/3c216d4e48a2cf35?lnk=gst&q=ggpairs#3c216d4e48a2cf35
but I obtained an error. Does anyone know why?

Cheers,

Marius


require(ggplot2)
require(GGally)
require(grid)

df <- data.frame(x1=rnorm(500), x2=rnorm(500), x3=rnorm(500))
ggpairs(df, alpha=I(0.3), diag="blank")
